name: Galbot ET1
summary: A 1.25 m, 32 kg walking humanoid for stage shows, theme parks and shop-front greeting, on pre-order in China only.

germany.statusNote: Pre-orders run through JD.com and Galbot's Chinese site; no Galbot distributor or customer in the EU found. A US-run German-language shop (Roboter Deutschland) takes quote requests, but its listing gives specs that contradict the maker (1.73 m, 65 kg instead of 1.25 m, 32 kg).

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: RK3588 + RDK X5; Pro adds Jetson Orin Nano (40 TOPS), Flagship Orin NX (100 TOPS)

notes: Built for entertainment: dancing, theme-park and storefront interaction, stage comedy. No payload, runtime or IP rating published.
Dexterous hands only on the Pro and Flagship versions (+12 DoF); the Standard version has none.
Galbot's site links a developer portal, but no SDK for the ET1 is described.

images.alt: Galbot ET1 bipedal humanoid, white with purple accents, standing

evidence.task: Greets customers and introduces products at a street-side shop
evidence.note: Maker scenario; not a construction or industrial task.

evidence.task: Over 200 pre-orders in the first 24 hours after pre-orders opened

sources.title: Galbot Opens Pre-Orders for ET1 Bipedal Humanoid Aimed at Entertainment and Performance

Galbot Launches Pre-Orders for ET1 Bipedal Humanoid Robot Targeting Entertainment Sector

openQuestions: Price per version (Standard, Pro, Flagship): not published; the JD.com listing did not load.
Delivery dates and any plan to sell outside China.
Payload, runtime, battery and stair ability are not published.
The Roboter Deutschland page describes a 1.73 m, 65 kg robot with 48 + 24 DoF and Jetson Thor, which does not match Galbot's own ET1 spec table; its data should not be used.
